facts.clasping: A person wearing a crown hugs one pentacle tightly to the chest with both arms.
facts.crown-pentacle: One pentacle sits on top of the crown.
facts.feet-pentacles: Both feet rest on two pentacles.
facts.seated: The person sits facing front before a stone base.
facts.city: A city with walls and towers can be seen behind.

glosses.feet-pentacles: Gripping even beneath the feet, so unable to move.
glosses.city: Safety guarded with the back turned to the outside world.

reversedGloss.excess: Anxious, so gripping tighter and growing stingy.
reversedGloss.waning: The clutching hand loosens, sharing and letting things flow.
